name: Vase
summary: This beaker-shaped vase was produced at the kilns of Jingdezhen, in south-east China, during the early 18th century, when the fashion for Chinese porcelain was at its highest in Europe. Jingdezhen thrived at the time as the major ceramic centre in China, supplying both the domestic and export market
